figurative_meaning_bn: ভোগের সময় আত্মীয়, কাজের সময় নয়
figurative_meaning_en: Relatives during times of enjoyment or feasting, but absent during times of work or hardship
similar_in_english: Only show up for the good times
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বাড়াভাতে কুটুম্ব, উৎসবে আসে কিন্তু কাজে কখনো সাহায্য করে না।
আমার চাচা বাড়াভাতে কুটুম্ব, শুধু খাবারের জন্য আসে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a fair-weather relative, showing up for the feast but never helping with the work.
My uncle is only around for the meals, a true example of relatives during good times but not in need.
note: This idiom highlights traditional Bengali family gatherings where extended relatives participate in celebrations but avoid responsibilities.
